name: Starlink
tagline: Largest LEO broadband constellation — ~6,500–7,000 active satellites
description: SpaceX's broadband LEO constellation — ~6,500–7,000 active satellites at 550 km altitude split across multiple shells (53°, 70°, 97.6° inclinations). First operational service 2019; achieved global coverage 2023. Each Gen-2 satellite carries laser inter-satellite links, allowing the constellation to route packets between satellites without ground station hops. Autonomous collision-avoidance system performs tens of thousands of manoeuvres per year — more than every other LEO operator combined.
best_known_for: Largest LEO broadband constellation — ~6,500–7,000 active satellites
